create_WaymoDataset: create a WaymoDataset instance with data_root, ann_file, and split for 3D object detection experiments
get_data_info_WaymoDataset: get data info dict with sample_idx, pts_filename, lidar2img transform, and annotation for a given index
evaluate_WaymoDataset: evaluate detection results using Waymo or KITTI metrics and return mAP and mAPH scores per class
format_results_WaymoDataset: format detection outputs to KITTI or Waymo binary format for evaluation and test submission
convert_valid_bboxes_WaymoDataset: convert predicted 3D bounding boxes from LiDAR to camera coordinates and filter by point cloud limit range
